title: quality_readiness-enforces-guide-definition-of-done data contracts
description: The DoD manifest format, the guide_compliance output, and the additive readiness keys. All additions are backward compatible (existing readiness keys unchanged).

DodManifest.description: templates/<stage>.dod.json — the machine mirror of a GUIDE Required-deliverables table (DD-1).

guide.description: path to the human GUIDE.md SSOT

guide_row.description: the row in the GUIDE table this mirrors (sync anchor)

any_of.description: alternative paths (literal or glob); first match = present

all_of.description: a GUIDE row requiring several files; present iff all match

DodStatusOverride.description: <base>/dod_status.json — an auditable way to mark a deliverable honestly deferred without faking a file (DD-3).

GuideCompliance.description: Additive on every readiness to_dict(). dod_ok is the real done-gate.

ReadinessAdditions.description: New keys on stage readiness to_dict(): c00 carries fake_complete_fields; all carry guide_compliance + dod_ok. package_readiness carries dod_missing (list of stages).

dod_ok.description: the real done-gate; true only when DoD passes AND (c00) no fake-complete / RF violation

fake_complete_fields.description: c00: answered fields whose value is a placeholder

dod_missing.description: package: stages whose GUIDE DoD is not met
